items.title: WTW Survey Reveals Specialty Insurance Has Lost 65% of Hard-Market Gains
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, a recent survey by WTW indicates that specialty insurance and reinsurance rate softening accelerated sharply through the first half of 2026.

items.title: Anthropic Warns of AI Protection Gap in Nasdaq IPO Filing
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, in its recent Form S-1 registration statement, artificial intelligence developer Anthropic cautioned investors that catastrophic AI-related incidents could exceed the capacity and expertise of the global insurance market.

items.title: AmTrust Acquires Wakam Following Regulatory Intervention in France
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, amTrust International has completed the acquisition of French insurer Wakam after financial pressures and regulatory restrictions led to a suspension of new business writing.

items.title: Insurance Dementia Campaign Expands Beyond London
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, insurance United Against Dementia has raised over £13m since 2017 and is now targeting regional markets, life firms, and reinsurers for its next phase.

items.title: Search Underway for the UK's Top Insurance Employers 2027
items.summary: Insurance Business UK launches its annual workplace excellence ranking, supported by the Insurance Cultural Awareness Network.

items.title: L&G Takes On £2.45bn Royal Mail DC Scheme in Record Master Trust Transfer
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, the completed transition moves £2.45bn in assets and approximately 100,000 members into the L&G Mastertrust.
